instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Outdoors on a sunny day near brick steps, the woman in the pink cardigan (R1) stands on the left, facing right and smiling joyfully with open arms. The man in the light blue shirt (R2) stands on the right, shown from a side-back angle as he reaches out to hug her. They are stepping together to initiate a warm embrace. Bright, natural sunlight illuminates the scene, creating a warm color palette with soft shadows.
